facts.fact: Starting in API version v26, COUPON is supported as a lead type across Local Services and Local Services Performance Max campaigns.

facts.fact: The contact_details field of a Local Services lead is null when lead_status equals WIPED_OUT.

facts.fact: Lead data from leads whose category_id is part of a healthcare category is not available through this API.

facts.fact: To access the call recording URL for a lead conversation, the signed-in email must have at least read-only access to the Google Ads client account that owns the associated campaign.
facts.quote: To access the call recording URL, you must sign in with an email address that has at least read-only access to the Google Ads client account that owns the campaign that the lead is associated with.

facts.fact: A Local Services campaign or Local Services Performance Max campaign must exist in the client account making the request for these resources to return data.
facts.quote: there must be a Local Services campaign or Local Services Performance Max campaign in the client account making the request.

facts.fact: Pay-per-lead Performance Max campaigns are linked to leads when advertising_channel_type is PERFORMANCE_MAX and pmax_campaign_settings.local_services_enabled is true.
facts.quote: `campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'PERFORMANCE_MAX'` and `campaign.pmax_campaign_settings.local_services_enabled = true`

facts.fact: A Local Services lead is one generated when a consumer calls, messages, books a service, or uses a coupon from the advertiser.
facts.quote: exposes the details of a lead that are generated when a consumer calls, messages, books a service, or uses a coupon from the advertiser.

facts.fact: Each Local Services lead can have many conversations, so the lead-to-conversation relationship is one-to-many.
facts.quote: There is a one-to-many relationship with `LocalServicesLead`, where one lead can have many conversations.

facts.fact: Requesting all lead conversations at once can be time-consuming, so the documentation recommends filtering conversations by lead.

facts.fact: Each verification artifact represents a single verification request, and a new artifact is created each time a verification request is submitted to Local Services Ads.

facts.fact: The local_services_enabled field on pmax_campaign_settings is an immutable CREATE ONLY boolean set to true at campaign creation.

facts.fact: Starting in v26, country_code is required and immutable for Local Services Performance Max campaigns, and only US is currently supported.
facts.quote: (currently, only `US` is supported for Local Services Performance Max campaigns)

facts.fact: If phone_numbers is omitted for a Local Services campaign, the call number defaults to the phone number on the linked Google Business Profile listing, and phone_numbers is required if that listing has no phone number.
facts.quote: If omitted, the call number defaults to the phone number on the linked Google Business Profile listing, and is required if the Business Profile listing does not have a phone number.

facts.fact: The DESTINATION_PHONE_NUMBER_FOR_ADS phone number type is the destination number for calls from a Local Services ad unit and is the default for call leads.
facts.quote: `DESTINATION_PHONE_NUMBER_FOR_ADS`: Destination number to use for calls from a Local Services ad unit (for call leads, default).

facts.fact: The DESTINATION_PHONE_NUMBER_FOR_SMS_ONLY phone number type is an optional destination number that supports SMS, used for message lead SMS notifications.
facts.quote: `DESTINATION_PHONE_NUMBER_FOR_SMS_ONLY`: Destination number that supports SMS (optional, for message lead SMS notifications).
